news.title: Liverpool opens Bengaluru campus with nearly 300 students
news.summary_en: The University of Liverpool has officially opened its Bengaluru campus, welcoming nearly 300 students and becoming the first Russell Group university to establish a campus in Karnataka.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: University of Manchester plans Bengaluru centre in India push
news.summary_en: The proposed centre will focus on industry-linked learning and research collaboration, adding to a growing UK presence spanning campuses and partnership hubs.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Ireland’s international education sector risks hitting “social license wall”
news.summary_en: Housing pressures, perceptions of racism and concerns over graduate outcomes risk undermining public support for international students, panellists at the second edition of The PIE Live Ireland have warned.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Firmli plans AI co-pilot for international student recruitment
news.summary_en: The Norwegian company’s planned November launch will bring together student applications and communications to help recruitment teams identify issues requiring attention.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Overseas student commencements fall 5% in Australian higher education
news.summary_en: International student commencements at Australian higher education providers fell by almost 5% year-on-year in the first part of 2026, according to new preliminary government data.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: International graduates deliver $1.7tn lifetime boost to host economies
news.summary_en: International students who graduated in 2024 are projected to contribute USD $1.7 trillion to their host economies over their working lives, according to new global research seeking to put a price on their post-study impact.
news.author: Kim Martin
